title: AI agents are becoming the new checkout; our store must be agent-ready
summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents pay at retailer checkouts; Klarna joined Adyen’s agent suite; Alexa shopping reached 15 countries; Target’s AI assistant lifted sales. Tablets fell 23% in Q3; PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028.

points.headline: Agent checkout is live and widening to BNPL
points.detail: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, Klarna joined Adyen’s agentic suite, and Alexa shopping reached 15 countries. We should make our catalog, checkout and financing agent-ready.

points.headline: Retailers see AI assistants and fast delivery driving sales
points.detail: Target’s Ask Target shows an early sales lift and Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% on fulfillment speed. We should test guided shopping and match delivery promises.

points.headline: PC and tablet supply is tight while notebook demand stays weak
points.detail: Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3, notebooks stay weak through Q2 2027 and the PCB shortage runs to mid-2028. We should plan inventory, pricing and promotions accordingly.

points.headline: Small-business spending is strong, consumers stay price-conscious
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small-business holiday spending while NRF finds affordability shapes consumer plans. We should push business bundles and clear value offers.
